I build backend systems and developer tools, mostly in Rust. I like understanding what happens below the surface: how queries run, how services communicate, and where programs spend time.

I started by taking Android apps apart, then building my own. That curiosity led me to cryptography libraries, GraphQL runtimes, and tools for coding agents.
